dct_description_sm: Data collected from the "Increasing lodging resistance in oats for enhanced quality and yield" field trial. The trial took place in 2020 and 2021 at the New Liskeard and Winchester Research Stations. Five agronomy management practices were tested: row spacing, seeding rate, seeding depth, split-nitrogen fertilizer applications, use of a plant growth regulator. Various crop and soil data were collected, including yield, yield components, grain quality, lodging (visual rating), root safety factor.
dct_title_s: Increasing lodging resistance in oats for enhanced quality and yield
